summary: US forces struck Iranian missile launchers on Qeshm Island and southern coastal sites following Iranian missile launches, while Houthi missiles triggered sirens across Saudi Arabia and multiple explosions occurred in Iranian cities including Tabriz and Jask. Iran signaled it will not escalate further before the US implements seven demands conveyed via Vice President Vance's letter. An Israeli soldier was charged with spying for Iran, transferring military base data and photos of US assets.

points: An explosion occurred at the Shahid Karimi residential complex in the Dampezeshki area of Tabriz, East Azerbaijan Province at 2038Z, reported via FromIran with 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11737)
UAV activity was heard over the customs warehouse in Sahlan near Amand Dam, Tabriz, East Azerbaijan Province at 2125Z, per delayed FromIran post. (Source: @shin_persian/11738)
Locals confirmed three blasts in Jask, Hormozgan Province at 2117Z (00:47 local time), reported via FromIran with 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11739)
Intense air-defense fire was observed in Qeshm, Hormozgan Province at 1919Z, per delayed FromIran post. (Source: @shin_persian/11734)

A CENTCOM official stated the US Air Force struck a missile launcher on Qeshm Island earlier after Iran launched missiles from the area, noting the area had been watched over the last week. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9088)
Barak Ravid confirmed self-defense strikes on IRGC launchers have been taking place at Iranian southern coastal sites. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9086)

(Source: @amitsegal/66594, @yediotnews25/137026)

The Shin Bet stated that intelligence on suspected voter fraud originated from foreign influence collection, not political parties; the investigation is focused and limited in scope, and does not cast aspersions on any sector. (Source: @manniefabian/59452)
Additional air defense assets, including a Patriot battery, are moving into CENTCOM area with deployment to Ovda, Israel, per analysis of CENTCOM posture changes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9080)
A fuel tanker aircraft was detected departing from Lod airport (referred to as occupied) without appearing on radar tracking sites. (Source: @redlinkleb/50552)
Artillery shelling was reported at Doha Kfar Rumman in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/50547)

Daily statistics for October 29, 2026 show 67 total alerts, 19 drone sightings (most in Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Harat Hreik with 2 each), and 32 artillery shelling incidents across locations including Al-Mansouri (6), Mayfadoun (5), Wadi Zibqin (4), Kfar Tibnit (3), and others. (Source: @redlinkleb/50551)
Houthi terrorists launched a massive missile strike on Saudi Arabia, triggering sirens in several provinces. (Source: @shin_persian/11723)

Gulf states have reportedly been told to prepare for a short, intense campaign after the US midterms; the US has ordered non-essential staff out of Saudi Arabia and cut staffing in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar, and the UAE, with troop numbers quietly reduced at some bases. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9080)
CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper provided a classified briefing to the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Defense on the Iran war on September 29. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9087)

Admiral Cooper briefed President Trump at the White House on Iran's military options on February 26, alongside Secretary Hegseth and Chairman Caine, two days before hostilities began. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9080)

sections.threat_assessment: Direct kinetic exchange between US and Iranian forces has occurred with US strikes on Qeshm Island and southern coastal IRGC launchers following Iranian missile launches. Houthi missile strikes on Saudi Arabia demonstrate persistent regional proxy capability. Multiple unexplained explosions in Tabriz, Jask, and air defense activity in Qeshm suggest either Israeli sabotage, internal accidents, or Iranian air defense responses. Iran's conditional restraint pending US implementation of seven demands indicates a calibrated escalation management strategy. Israeli counterintelligence failure with a soldier recruited by Iranian intelligence for over a year, providing data on US assets, reveals significant penetration. Lebanon faces sustained artillery and drone attacks. US force posture changes — Patriot deployment to Ovda, diplomatic drawdowns, congressional war briefings — signal preparation for wider conflict.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are reportedly preparing for a short, intense campaign after US midterms, with Washington ordering non-essential staff evacuations from Saudi Arabia and staffing cuts in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar, and UAE. Israel's political leadership has been briefed by Shin Bet on foreign election interference while managing domestic unrest. Lebanon's daily alert statistics show persistent low-intensity conflict. Iran communicates red lines through backchannels via Al-Mayadeen, linking further actions to US compliance with seven demands. The FCDO upgraded risk assessments for 13 countries to 'deeply unpredictable' with high risk of sudden escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed reporting from Iran via FromIran suggests operational security measures and possible communications monitoring. Qeshm Island strikes indicate US targeting of Iranian missile launch infrastructure used in recent attacks. Houthi strike on KSA demonstrates continued missile capability despite sustained pressure. Israeli soldier case reveals Iranian intelligence targeting of US refueling aircraft and interceptor systems in Israel. Admiral Cooper's White House briefing two days before hostilities began and subsequent Senate briefing indicate deliberate US escalation planning. The UKMTO warning 186-26 reflects maritime security concerns in the region.
